subject: BI tooling renewal — Looker license vs Metabase migration POC and PO timing
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@looker-sales.com>, Tom Richards <tom.richards@metabase.io>, Andrew Park <andrew@data-ops.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: BI tooling renewal — Looker license vs Metabase migration POC and PO timing

Team / vendors —

Quick context: our current Looker renewal window opens mid-November. Before we commit to another 12-month enterprise renewal, leadership wants a short, targeted evaluation of whether a partial migration to Metabase + BigQuery (or staying with Looker) gives meaningful cost and admin benefits without regressing on self-serve analytics.

Attached: redwood_bi_rfp.pdf, tco_model_markus_v3.xlsx — the TCO has current run-rate, seat counts, and a simple delta calc for a phased Metabase migration.

Asks:
- Vendors: please confirm a written estimate for a 6-week POC (including any sandbox credits, support hours, migration assistance). PDFs OK.
- Procurement (Laura/Monica): confirm the latest PO deadline for any renewal discounts and whether we can do a short-term extension (1–2 months) if we need more time.
- Ops (Hannah): confirm any data residency / security constraints for Metabase hosting; list required SOC/Security docs.

Target outcome: baseline run-rate and two POC offers (Looker-assisted option and Metabase POC) by next Friday so leadership can greenlight one.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Analytics Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: tco_model_markus_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
Attachment: redwood_bi_rfp.pdf (pdf, 450KB)

From: Tom Richards <tom.richards@metabase.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Andrew Park <andrew@data-ops.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BI tooling renewal — Looker license vs Metabase migration POC and PO timing

Hi Markus / team —

Thanks for the RFP and TCO, appreciate the clarity. Short reply: Metabase can run a 6-week POC for the core self-serve surfaces you noted. High-level commercial: we can provide a sandbox cluster credit to cover GCP costs for the POC (up to $20k), 8 hours of onboarding from our Solutions Engineers, and a flat POC fee of $7,500 for custom connectors and dashboards.

We also attach a short estimate (metabase_estimate_2026-09-30.pdf) with an optional 12-month hosted plan price and an enterprise self-hosted license price for comparison. Key notes:
- We support BigQuery natively; can assist with query optimization and caching for common dashboard queries.
- Data residency: if you self-host Metabase, data stays in your VPC; for our hosted plan we have EU/US region options.

Propose a 30-min kickoff demo + scope call Thu 10/1 at 11am PT — does that work?

Best,
Tom
Tom Richards
Enterprise Sales, Metabase

Attachment: metabase_estimate_2026-09-30.pdf (pdf, 95KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@looker-sales.com>, Tom Richards <tom.richards@metabase.io>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BI tooling renewal — Looker license vs Metabase migration POC and PO timing

Thanks — quick procurement note from our side:

- Renewal window: finance needs a signed PO by 2026-11-14 to secure current movement discounts on Looker. We can extend the current contract for up to 45 days via amendment (legal approval required) if vendors agree to hold pricing and provide written confirmation.
- Approval path: PO -> Legal -> Finance; typical lead time is 7 business days once PO is uploaded.
- For any new vendor engagements (Metabase), please include an SOW or itemized cost list; we prefer fixed-fee POCs.

Emily / Tom: can you confirm the following in writing?
1) Whether you can hold current pricing for 45 days if we request an extension.
2) Any migration assistance credits / discounted consulting hours for an enterprise migration.
3) Minimum term for enterprise licensing (if we transition fully).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: po_template.docx (docx, 24KB)

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@looker-sales.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@looker-sales.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BI tooling renewal — Looker license vs Metabase migration POC and PO timing

Hi Markus / Laura / team —

Appreciate the heads up and the TCO. We want to be pragmatic — Looker will offer the following to support a fair evaluation:
- We can provide two months of platform credits (applied to invoices) to support parallel testing for the POC.
- Migration assistance: 30 hours of professional services at a 50% discount (applied if you choose Looker migration).
- Pricing hold: we can hold current list pricing for 45 days with a signed non-binding extension letter; legal can push a short amendment through.

I'll attach a draft enterprise amendment and a commercial summary. If you want to move fast, I can circulate a DocuSign for the extension letter today — we'll need a primary signature from your finance lead.

Emily Zhao
Account Executive, Looker (Google Cloud)

Attachment: looker_enterprise_offer_2026-10-01.pdf (pdf, 130KB)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123LOOKER

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 18:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: BI tooling renewal — Looker license vs Metabase migration POC and PO timing

Thanks everyone — good signal. Quick plan:

1) We will run two parallel 6-week POCs (Metabase hosted/self-hosted option + Looker-supported parallel testing) focused on:
   - common dashboards (top 25 queries),
   - developer productivity for ad-hoc analysis, and
   - end-user latency/SLAs under expected query load.
2) Logistics: kickoff week of 10/5. Tom — confirm kickoff 10/5 11am PT and provide onboarding SE contact. Emily — thanks, please send the DocuSign extension letter to Laura so procurement can sign the hold.
3) Action items assigned: Monica to coordinate environment provisioning; Laura to confirm PO vs extension timing; Hannah to validate security docs and list any blockers by 10/6.
4) Deliverables we expect from vendors by POC start: statement of work or POC scope, itemized fees (if any), and a named SE/PM contact.

I'll upload the PO template and the POC scope to the shared Drive and create a HubSpot deal (HUB-2026-0583) so we have one record.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Analytics Platform
Redwood Inference
